_comment: Canonical phrasing list per class -- single source of truth for recording and dummy data. Phrasings include common public-dataset wordings (SLURP / Fluent Speech Commands / Speech Commands) so recorded clips match a merged distribution. _silence_ has no spoken prompt (record ambient/no speech).

lights_dim: dim the lights to fifty percent
set the brightness to thirty percent
set_timer: set a timer for five minutes
set a timer for ten minutes
set a countdown for one minute
set a timer for thirty seconds
set_alarm: set an alarm for seven a m
set an alarm for eight thirty
set an alarm for six thirty in the morning
set_thermostat: set the temperature to twenty four degrees
increase the temperature by two degrees
reminders: add eggs to my shopping list
remind me to take my medicine
_unknown_: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
